author: mark
text:
state: track unmerged branches in branches.json

.agent/state/branches.json is now a harness-managed JSON map
keyed by branch name, written atomically on exchange spawn.
Entry shape: kind / spawned_at / base_sha / status (+ optional
stopped_at). Merge removes the entry; map length is the §8
unmerged-branch-count health metric.

File is runtime state, gitignored from the template so per-branch
trees can't carry stale snapshots. Writes are temp-file-plus-rename
for safe concurrent reads. Merge-back (separate task) calls
branches::remove after landing the no-ff merge.
